calls.bash: mu task claim s1 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do s1'
mu task close s1 -w eval --evidence 's1 done'
mu task claim s2 -w eval --for w1
mu agent send w1 -w eval --json 'do s2'
mu task close s2 -w eval --evidence 's2 done'
git cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path w1 -w eval) rev-parse HEAD~1) $(git -C $(mu workspace path w1 -w eval) rev-parse HEAD)

text: s1 and s2 done and merged.
